jobs.title: Cross-Sell Data Analyst, Dynamics 365
jobs.description:
About Us

At HUB International, we are a team of entrepreneurs. We believe in protecting and supporting the aspirations of individuals, families, and businesses. We help our clients evaluate their risks and develop solutions tailored to their needs. We believe in empowering our employees to learn, grow, and make a difference. Our structure enables our teams to maintain their own unique, regional culture while leveraging support and resources from our corporate centers of excellence.

HUB is a global insurance and employee benefits broker, providing a boundaryless array of business insurance, employee benefits, risk services, personal insurance, retirement, and private wealth management products and services. With over $5 billion in revenue and almost 20,000 employees in 700 offices throughout North America, HUB has grown substantially, in part due to our industry leading success in mergers and acquisitions.

Cross-Sell Data Analyst

The cross-sell data analyst is responsible for identifying cross-sell opportunities within the producer's book across all business lines for the region by analyzing both internal and external data sources, such as the 5500 form. The analyst will provide data-driven insights to enhance cross-sell opportunities. Additionally, the individual will collaborate with the national teams for Commercial, Employee Benefits, Retirement & Private Wealth and Personal Lines, as well as with the regional cross-sell coordinator, to support producer engagement and cross-selling initiatives. This role reports to National Chief Cross-Sell Officer.

Success is measured by the ability to perform in-depth analysis using both internal and external data sources and communicate data-driven insights into cross-sell opportunities to producers and advisors.

Responsibilities

Conduct in-depth analyses of producers' books to identify potential cross-sell leads and help build a pipeline of cross-selling opportunities.
Utilize data mining and analytics/AI methods to generate key insights into prospects, such as gaps in services, excessive fees, benchmarks for improvements, elevated fiduciary exposure, financial health indicators, current broker/advisor capabilities, etc, to spot opportunities.
Identify trends within the data and provide actionable insights and recommendations for producers.
Generate reports in Power BI, Excel, and other tools based on collected data.
Build and maintain relationships with producers, the regional cross-selling team, and other business stakeholders.
Perform additional job-related duties as needed

Other Requirements Include

Bachelor's degree with a major in Data Science, Statistics, Business, Finance, Economics
Insurance Industry experience required
At least 5+ years of experience in the same or related role preferred
Experience using Power BI and/or AI tool
Dynamics 365 experience
Ability to apply an investigative approach and facility with large data sets to uncover lead and cross-selling opportunities
Ability to create standard and ad hoc reports
Ability to derive insights and create recommendations
Must be detail-oriented and possess strong listening skills
Previous experience at a carrier or insurance broker preferred
Strong communication, analytical, interpersonal, multi-tasking, and organizational skills required
The preferred candidate is a team player with self-motivation, and the ability to meet critical deadlines and work in a fast-paced environment

JOIN OUR TEAM

Do you believe in the power of innovation, collaboration, and transformation? Do you thrive in a supportive and client focused work environment? Are you looking for an opportunity to help build and drive change in a rapidly growing and evolving organization? When you join HUB International
, you will be part of a community of learners and doers focused on our Core Values: entrepreneurship, teamwork, integrity, accountability, and service.

The expected salary range for this position is $80,000 to $120,000 and will be impacted by factors such as the successful candidate’s skills, experience and working location, as well as the specific position’s business line, scope and level. HUB International is proud to offer comprehensive benefit and total compensation packages which could include health/dental/vision/life/disability insurance, FSA, HSA and 401(k) accounts, paid-time-off benefits such as vacation, sick, personal, floating holidays and company holidays. In addition, eligible annual bonuses, equity and commissions may be available for some positions.

Department Sales

Required Travel: Up to 50%

Required Education: High school or equivalent
